title: the_coworkers_badge_photo
display_title: My coworker's badge photo wasn't her — and I'm the only one who noticed
beats: I've worked next to the same woman for two years, and her ID badge photo is not her face.
Close, but the nose is wrong, the ear piercings are different, and I noticed the first week and said nothing.
I told myself it was a printing error, renewed my own badge twice since then, never said a word.
Last month the real woman in that photo messaged our company's public email asking if anyone had seen her sister.
I still haven't answered, and 'she' still says good morning to me every single day.
